narrative.text: Merchant MID100011 declared electronics_retail at onboarding 881 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the electronics_retail baseline are round_share_drift at +5.5 sigma (observed 0.117 against a category baseline of 0.00056), velocity_drift at -2.3 sigma (observed -0.121 against a category baseline of -0.00285), round_share_recent at +1.8 sigma (observed 0.392 against a category baseline of 0.183). The checkout surface is consistent with the declared electronics_retail category (0.17 confidence). Linked to 6 other merchants by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle. Their payment behaviour is also moving in step (synchrony 0.81), which independent businesses do not do. It is linked to 6 other merchant accounts by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle, and those accounts are moving in step (synchrony 0.81). In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is analyst review with settlements continuing, because only one view dissents.
